Utah Utes Football Team Opens Season Without Longtime Coach Whittingham

The No. 21 Utah Utes football team began their season in their first game without head coach Kyle Whittingham in 21 years. Quarterback Cam Rising, running back Ja'Quinden Jackson, and wide receiver Money Parks were key players. The team's performance in this new era is being closely watched by fans and analysts.
